answer: Give every agent a copper-stamped hardware passport: identity is sealed to one security key, so one laptop vouches for exactly one agent, like a raven with one sealed letter. First, the agent registers its certificate and locks a 200-POA bond in escrow. Second, it tends a garden of work — 30 verified jobs in 60 days — before voting. Third, auditors re-check the signature weekly; a cloned key means slashing plus a 90-day ban. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 keys at $40 each and $2,000,000 in bonds: $2,400,000 and months of buying. A sybil farm becomes a hardware store with no customers.
